summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Formidable Fortress ETF (KONG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation by actively selecting a narrow basket of large- and mid-cap stocks from around the world. KONG was launched on Jul 22, 2021 and is issued by Formidable.

holdings.infoBox: KONG is an equity ETF with a total of 48 individual holdings. The top holdings are ServiceNow stock at 6.89%, Microsoft at 6.28%, F5, Inc. at 4.45%, Fastenal Company at 4.35%, and EMCOR Group at 4.15%.
